concept: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
question: In which year did Henri Becquerel discover that uranium salts emit a penetrating radiation that can be registered on a photographic plate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1896**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• H**enry Becquerel in 1896 discovered radioactivity proving that the uranium emitted radiation without an external source of energy such as the Sun.**
 
• Uranium, Polonium is the radioactive element exhibit in nature.
 
• Marie Curie, who together with her husband Pierre, actually coined the term radioactivity and began investigating the phenomenon recently discovered by Becquerel.
 
• Ernest Rutherford did many experiments studying the properties of radioactive decay, named this alpha, beta, and gamma particles, and classified them by their ability to penetrate matter.
 
• Enrico Fermi works were on the artificial radioactivity produced by neutrons, and for nuclear reactions brought about by slow neutrons.
